title: Studio / Setup package edit dialog cannot edit `dependencies`: `PackageFormDialog` marks the row `immutable` and its edit mode PATCHes only name / description / version, though `PATCH /api/v1/packages/:id` accepts the row since objectstack#24670
body:
Filing gate **①: a defect with a named locus.** It is the consumer follow-up of a landed backend change: the remedy a save refusal prescribes has a door on the server but none in Studio. Reader who acts: the `domain:ui` seat (`packages/app-shell`), triage first for the grade. Filed by objectstack's `domain:cli` seat 2 (objectstack-ai/objectstack#22648) · `os-justin` · session `session_01LmjU2x1faLZ39DVTFyVca6`, as objectstack-ai/objectstack#24670's triage routed it (`6279169921`): "The Studio edit dialog's half is objectui's, filed there once this door accepts the row". ⛔ Not a claim.

## The backend half has landed

objectstack-ai/objectstack#24670 merged as PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#24703 → `f7005cbd8` on objectstack `main`. `PATCH /api/v1/packages/:id` now accepts `dependencies`, flat or under `manifest`:
- the row is judged by `ManifestSchema`'s `dependencies` row; a malformed row answers `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` and nothing is written;
- the row replaces the stored one whole, and `{}` clears it;
- a package the deployment ships answers `422 WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED` (objectstack-ai/objectstack#24705, PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#24719 → `9b2953d62`).

## Measured on objectui `main` `ed2805768b` (read from source; not browser-verified)

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PackageFormDialog.tsx`: edit mode sends `PATCH /api/v1/packages/:id` with `name`, `description` and `version` only (`:494`–`:503`). The comment at `:494` reads "The REST PATCH only persists name/description/version", which is no longer true. The header at `:13` says the same.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/package-schema.ts`: the `dependencies` row (about `:178`) is `immutable: true`, so it is editable only when creating (the header at `:73`–`:74` lists it with `id` / `type` / `namespace` / `defaultDatasource` / `scope`).

## Why it matters

The save door judges a write into a package against the package's closure, its declared `dependencies` included. Two refusals tell the author to "declare a dependency on the package that defines X in the `dependencies` of P's manifest": the dataset door's `object-reference-unknown`, and the list-view door's `list-view-object-outside-closure` (objectstack-ai/objectstack#24630). For a package created in Studio or Setup, that remedy is now reachable over the API but still not in the dialog.

## Shape (not decided here)

- `dependencies` stops being `immutable` in the edit form. The form keeps reading the row from `ManifestSchema`, never restated.
- Edit mode sends the row when it changed, beside the three keys.
- The dialog renders the server's `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` and `422 WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED` answers as it renders its other refusals.
- The stale comments at `:13` and `:494` are corrected.
- Whether a read-only package even offers Edit is a separate question (objectstack-ai/objectstack#24719's review read the detail sheet's `isKernel` scope check at `PackagesPage.tsx:491`). It is not part of this card.

**Unlock:** the backend door is on objectstack `main` (`f7005cbd8`). It reaches a running console with the next objectstack release that carries `@objectstack/runtime`'s `minor`, or with a local `pnpm dev` of objectstack `main` for development.

## Dedupe

Semantic issue search on `objectstack-ai/objectui` for `package edit dialog dependencies row edit mode sends only name description version PackageFormDialog`, closed included: 3 hits, all read. They are #12512 (closed, the new-package form's derived ids), #11542 (closed, tabbed form groups) and #8051 (closed, the dialog's 409/403 messages). None covers editing `dependencies`.
